body: Deep-dive-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Live deep dive #3, company drawn at random from the cheapest EV/EBITDA tercile (method test, L9/L21). Probability 0.75 (naive base rate 0.5) that: Automotive Axles FY27 technical fees to Meritor HVS (India) are <= 4.75% of revenue from operations. Our reasoning: FY26 technical fees Rs 97.53 cr = 4.48% of revenue from operations Rs 2,177.7 cr [AR26 n.29, n.21]; the 29-Apr-2026 extension to 30-Apr-2027 states 'no impact'; the fee is reportedly not charged on group exports, and a falling export share adds about 0.1 pt mechanically. Naive base: a related-party fee around an annual renewal: coin flip [EST, unverified]. Resolution: YES if 'Technical fees' in the FY27 annual report's Other-expenses note divided by 'Total revenue from operations' (FY27 AR revenue note) is <= 4.75%. If the line is renamed, use the MHVSIL 'services received / technical fees' amount in the related-party note. Source: Automotive Axles FY2026-27 annual report (NSE annual_reports). Resolve by 2027-08-31; score with Brier vs the base rate.
